genre_target: CET-6 / IELTS Task 2 / TOEFL 让步反驳段（Body Paragraph 2 or 3）
domain_context: 顶会口头汇报（Tech Talk）与图表引导
communicative_intent_zh: 我这一段想在议论文中回应反方观点（Some people argue that...）：先大度承认反方担忧在短期或局部确实存在，再用结构性证据或制度设计证明该问题完全可控，从而锁死我方立场。
prompt_zh: 【表达意图→段落构建 1】假设你正在撰写【CET-6 / IELTS Task 2 / TOEFL 让步反驳段（Body Paragraph 2 or 3）】。你这一段的核心表达意图是：“我这一段想在议论文中回应反方观点（Some people argue that...）：先大度承认反方担忧在短期或局部确实存在，再用结构性证据或制度设计证明该问题完全可控，从而锁死我方立场。”。请严格按照 `BP36` 的逐句功能骨架（4 步法）与逻辑法则 `L006`（图尔敏五步微论证模型（Toulmin Micro-Argumentation）），写出一段 4–5 句、零 AI 痕迹、主语紧凑（≤6词）的自然英文段落。
source_material_or_draft: Some people think robots will take all our jobs and make everyone poor. This is wrong. Robots will create new jobs, and people can learn new skills to find better jobs easily.
structural_constraints: S1 [呈现反方最有力的担忧 Articulate Opposing Concern]：Admittedly, critics raise a valid concern that [Opposing Argument, e.g., automation displaces entry-level clerical and manufacturing workers].
S2 [承认局部真实性 Acknowledge Partial Validity]：In the short term, rapid deployment of [Technology/Policy] can indeed create transitional friction for workers whose routines are easily codified.
S3 [釜底抽薪式转折 Structural Pivot]：However, viewing [X] purely as a zero-sum threat overlooks how productivity gains generate entirely new categories of skilled employment.

S4 [历史/现实反证与制度补救 Evidence & Mitigation]：Just as spreadsheet software reduced manual bookkeeping while expanding demand for financial analysts, pairing automation with targeted vocational retraining allows displaced workers to transition into system supervision and maintenance roles.
target_defects_to_fix: 头重脚轻长主语 + 散装短句堆砌（Top-Heavy Subject & Choppy Flow）
消除头重脚轻（主语 ≤ 6-8 词，遵循尾重原则 L011）
消除口语词与 AI 套话（delve into / pivotal role / testament to）
补全定量指标-基线-条件三元组或具象行业微案例

genre_target: Statement of Purpose (SoP) / Research Statement / 学术自我介绍
domain_context: 托福独立与综合写作：理论基础与工程实践权衡
communicative_intent_zh: 我这一段想写申请博士/博后/访问学者或个人学术主页的 Research Statement / SoP 核心段：把我已经做过的深度学习/时间序列/生成模型工作，与我未来想探索的具身智能（Embodied AI）无缝串联成一条充满内驱力的科研主线。
prompt_zh: 【表达意图→段落构建 2】假设你正在撰写【Statement of Purpose (SoP) / Research Statement / 学术自我介绍】。你这一段的核心表达意图是：“我这一段想写申请博士/博后/访问学者或个人学术主页的 Research Statement / SoP 核心段：把我已经做过的深度学习/时间序列/生成模型工作，与我未来想探索的具身智能（Embodied AI）无缝串联成一条充满内驱力的科研主线。”。请按 `BP48` 的句子角色分工，先列出每句的主语核心词与谓语强动词，再连缀成完整段落。
source_material_or_draft: Time series imputation is very important in the era of big data. Existing generative models delve into the data distribution but are too slow and fail when missing rates are high. We propose FlowImp, a novel framework that uses conditional flow matching and frequency guidance. Extensive experiments show that FlowImp achieves state-of-the-art results on all benchmarks.
structural_constraints: S1 [过往研究主线凝练 Past Research Thread]：My prior research has centered on modeling non-stationary dynamics and uncertainty in high-dimensional sequential data.

S2 [代表作攻克过程与硬核成果 Concrete Achievement]：In my recent work on [Time Series / Generative Modeling], I observed that [Core Bottleneck], which led me to formulate [Method]—reducing long-horizon drift by [X%] across industrial telemetry benchmarks.

S3 [向具身智能跃迁的科学顿悟 Scientific Pivot to Embodied AI]：While passive sequence forecasting predicts how an environment evolves, physical decision-making requires closing the loop: actions actively alter future state distributions.

S4 [未来研究愿景 Future Research Agenda]：Building on my foundation in continuous-time generative modeling, my doctoral/future research aims to develop sample-efficient visuomotor world models that enable robots to adapt online to non-stationary contact dynamics.

消除口语词与 AI 套话（delve into / pivotal role / testament to）

genre_target: CET-6 / IELTS Task 2 / TOEFL 让步反驳段（Body Paragraph 2 or 3）
domain_context: 顶会口头汇报（Tech Talk）与图表引导
communicative_intent_zh: 我这一段想在议论文中回应反方观点（Some people argue that...）：先大度承认反方担忧在短期或局部确实存在，再用结构性证据或制度设计证明该问题完全可控，从而锁死我方立场。
prompt_zh: 【多段贯通写作实战 1：Research_Proposal 核心章节连写】参照全文样板 `FT12 (具身智能与非平稳时序建模交叉课题立项申请书（Research Proposal 全文：研究背景、核心科学问题、技术路线与预期成果）)` 的段落蓝图链 `BP01 -> BP02 -> BP03`，围绕你自己的研究方向（深度学习 / 时间序列 / 生成模型 / 具身智能）写出连续 3 个逻辑咬合的自然段，并标注段间过渡钩子（`L027`）。
source_material_or_draft: Some people think robots will take all our jobs and make everyone poor. This is wrong. Robots will create new jobs, and people can learn new skills to find better jobs easily.
structural_constraints: S1 [呈现反方最有力的担忧 Articulate Opposing Concern]：Admittedly, critics raise a valid concern that [Opposing Argument, e.g., automation displaces entry-level clerical and manufacturing workers].
S2 [承认局部真实性 Acknowledge Partial Validity]：In the short term, rapid deployment of [Technology/Policy] can indeed create transitional friction for workers whose routines are easily codified.
S3 [釜底抽薪式转折 Structural Pivot]：However, viewing [X] purely as a zero-sum threat overlooks how productivity gains generate entirely new categories of skilled employment.

S4 [历史/现实反证与制度补救 Evidence & Mitigation]：Just as spreadsheet software reduced manual bookkeeping while expanding demand for financial analysts, pairing automation with targeted vocational retraining allows displaced workers to transition into system supervision and maintenance roles.
target_defects_to_fix: 头重脚轻长主语 + 散装短句堆砌（Top-Heavy Subject & Choppy Flow）
